messages.author: Rowald
messages.text:
What is influence useful for then if it doesn't translate into WA leverage?
I propose smth in between like floor(log10(influence)), as in every power of 10 gives you another delegate, so bigger nations' votes still weigh more but not that much that it blows a potential smaller opposition's votes out of the park
